biggest_catch: The offer is only for members of the ACWA employer group — not every California resident qualifies — and you must hit both $400/month in Provident card purchases and $2,000/month in direct deposits for two straight months.
catches: Only members of the ACWA employer group are eligible — this is not a general California offer.

In each of two consecutive months (starting the month after account opening) you must make $400 in Provident card purchases, receive $2,000 in direct deposits/automatic credits, and use online banking with eDocuments.
New members/checking customers only; age 18+; California resident; one bonus per person and per household/address.
A $5 membership share is required to join; at least $25 must be deposited within 60 days of opening.
Account must remain active and in good standing through payout.
No fixed expiration — the credit union may end the offer at any time.

steps: Go to the official ACWA promo page at https://providentcu.org/who-we-serve/employer-groups/acwa and confirm you belong to the ACWA employer group before applying.
Open a new Provident checking account with promo code WELCOME475; pay the $5 membership share to establish membership.
Deposit at least $25 into the new account within 60 days of opening.

In each of two consecutive months, beginning the month after account opening: make at least $400 in purchases with your Provident card, receive at least $2,000 in direct deposits or automatic credits, and use online banking with eDocuments.
Keep the account open, active, and in good standing through the payout date.
Receive the $475 bonus, typically within 120 days of account opening.
